verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents JMAP session discovery at https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session and points to the IETF RFCs as the API specification, but its own developer page states this is per-account runtime discovery and that no downloadable OpenAPI-style spec exists. Probes of standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. Runtime capability discovery and prose RFCs are adjacent features, not a downloadable machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The JMAP session resource can be found at https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session
